label: Goal-relative force with indifference excludes preference-independent reasons
description: Conditional analyst argument, attribution deferred: if force at a preference requires the accuracy aim and some supplied preference lacks it, no reason has force at every supplied preference. Composed with the answerability argument in a separate checked theorem, the actual-force concession, answerability, the goal-relative account and an indifference alternative cannot all hold in one frame. Each premise fails in a finite control while the other holds.
